verdict.rationale: Smooth's docs show a natural-language goal handed straight to `smooth_client.run(...)` and executed end to end, here a Google Flights search. They also document the agent navigating multi-step forms with dropdowns and checkboxes, clicking through user flows, and chaining sequential tasks in one persistent session. A community user independently reports that a complex prompt 'did a good job'. Missing for 10: rigorous independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-step form completion reliability (community evidence is a single anecdotal comment, and reproducible evals were questioned).
